sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Regulated Materials is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Come on in, warrior! Still breathing aye? Good to hear. Here's a task for you. There's this customer, showed up outta nowhere with an urgent order and the bitch wants specific equipment, the one our glorious mother Russia produced, and my heart aches that the good of the state has to be sold to whoever. Judging by the accent, the fucker is from abroad. But the cash is noble and the connections he provides are no joke. Anyway, you need one military battery, the heavy one, and several OFZ shells. I feel you'll have to sneak on the military base for it... The place is inhospitable, I know, but you won't regret it when the checkout time comes. Plus, I’ll provide you with a special gift for this. Will you take the risk?"

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text:
- Find 1 6-STEN-140-M military battery in raid
- Hand over 1 military battery to Prapor
- Find 3 OFZ 30x165mm shells in raid
- Hand over the 3 OFZ shells to Prapor

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +65,000 EXP
- Prapor Rep +1.5
- 400,000 Roubles
  - 420,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 460,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
- Unlocks craft for 6-STEN-140-M military battery at Workbench level 1
- +2 Charisma skill levels

"Now that's the good stuff! Heavy as hell, yeah? So anyway, I keep my word about the reward, check out the new rifles I have..."

sections.heading: Guide
sections.text:
| Item name | Amount | Requirement | Find in raid | Notes |
| OFZ 30x165mm shell | 3 | Handover item | Yes | Can be crafted in the Hideout (Workbench lv. 3). |
| 6-STEN-140-M military battery | 1 | Handover item | Yes | |
The items required for this quest need to be found in raid. They can be found as Loose Loot on Lighthouse and Reserve, but can be found in containers elsewhere, as well as a small chance for a Scav to have it in their backpack. The 6-STEN-140-M military battery is a large 4x2 slot item that resembles a black/brown box. It can most commonly be found sitting on or near tanks. The OFZ 30x165mm shells can be found throughout the Reserve on tables, shelving and at the rear side of every tank on the map, on the ground. Both of the items required for this quest can also be obtained from the Scav Case in the Hideout.
